intro: One chicken wrap is about 450 kcal (estimate). Most of the calories come from the tortilla, chicken and mayo sauce.
diet: Yes, a chicken wrap can be a good office lunch. The protein is decent and it's easy to carry. Watch out for fried chicken and mayo. Choose grilled chicken, use less sauce, and it's very diet-friendly.
tips: Pick grilled chicken, not battered fried chicken.
Ask for less sauce or switch to chilli sauce.
No need to add fries. Have fruit for dessert instead.

swap.name: Chicken salad (dressing on the side)
swap.why: Similar protein but no tortilla, so fewer calories.

faq.q: Is a wrap healthier than a burger bun?
faq.a: Not always. A large tortilla has almost the same calories as a burger bun. The filling and sauce matter more.

faq.q: Can I make wraps for work bekal?
faq.a: Yes. Use grilled chicken, vegetables and sauce on the side so the tortilla doesn't get soggy. Wrap it in paper or foil.
It has more fibre, so it's more filling. The calories are about the same as a regular tortilla.
